title.es: Proyecto de escritura: borrador y edición

es: Editar un borrador corrigiendo formas, registro y conectores (although, however, therefore, whereas) y justificar los cambios.

teaching.en: My first draft had six mistakes, so I had to edit it carefully.
teaching.es: Mi primer borrador tenía seis errores, así que tuve que corregirlo con cuidado.
teaching.explanationEs: Draft y edit: primero escribes una versión y luego la editas por pasos: formas, registro y conectores.
segments: My first draft had six mistakes, so
I had to edit it carefully.
teaching.audioText: My first draft had six mistakes, so I had to edit it carefully.

teaching.en: Although the plan is cheap, it is not very effective.
teaching.es: Aunque el plan es barato, no es muy eficaz.
teaching.explanationEs: Although + oración, oración: no se añade but en la segunda parte.
teaching.audioText: Although the plan is cheap, it is not very effective.

teaching.en: The plan is cheap; however, it is not very effective.
teaching.es: El plan es barato; sin embargo, no es muy eficaz.
teaching.explanationEs: However une dos oraciones: punto y coma (o punto) antes y coma después.
teaching.audioText: The plan is cheap; however, it is not very effective.

teaching.en: The council did not act; therefore, the problem grew.
teaching.es: El ayuntamiento no actuó; por lo tanto, el problema creció.
teaching.explanationEs: Therefore introduce el resultado; mismo patrón de puntuación que however.
teaching.audioText: The council did not act; therefore, the problem grew.

teaching.en: Some students prefer books, whereas others prefer screens.
teaching.es: Algunos estudiantes prefieren los libros, mientras que otros prefieren las pantallas.
teaching.explanationEs: Whereas contrasta dos grupos o ideas dentro de una misma oración.
teaching.audioText: Some students prefer books, whereas others prefer screens.

teaching.en: His message was full of slang, so it sounded too casual for a job application.
teaching.es: Su mensaje estaba lleno de jerga, así que sonaba demasiado informal para una solicitud de trabajo.
teaching.explanationEs: Slang y contracciones dan un registro casual; en un texto formal se sustituyen por palabras neutras.
segments: His message was full of slang, so it
sounded too casual for a job application.
teaching.audioText: His message was full of slang, so it sounded too casual for a job application.

prompt.es: Elige la corrección del conector en la frase del borrador.

choices.text: Although the bus is cheap, however it is slow.
Although the bus is cheap, it is slow.
Although the bus is cheap but it is slow.

feedback.es: Although ya expresa el contraste; en la segunda parte no se añade but ni however.

hint.es: Con although no se necesita otro conector en la segunda parte.

origin.text: Draft: “Although the bus is cheap, but it is slow.”

prompt.es: Completa: «El autobús es barato; sin embargo, es lento.»

feedback.es: However une dos oraciones con contraste: punto y coma antes y coma después.

hint.es: Es el conector de contraste entre dos oraciones.

origin.text: The bus is cheap; ___, it is slow.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Algunos prefieren el tren, mientras que otros prefieren el coche.»

answer.text: Some prefer the train whereas others prefer the car

feedback.es: Whereas contrasta los dos grupos dentro de una misma oración, sin punto y coma.

hint.es: Whereas une las dos partes sin punto y coma.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada conector con lo que hace en el texto.

pairs.es: concesión al inicio de la frase

feedback.es: Although concede al inicio, whereas contrasta dos grupos, however contrasta entre oraciones y therefore presenta la consecuencia.

pairs.es: concesión al inicio de la frase

prompt.es: Completa el borrador con el conector adecuado en cada hueco.

feedback.es: Therefore presenta la consecuencia de que la carretera estuviera cerrada y although concede que las entradas eran caras.

sentences: The road was closed; ___, we took the train.
___ the tickets were expensive, we bought two.

prompt.es: Elige la versión formal de esta frase informal.

choices.text: The kids can't stand the noise, and it's a mess!
The children can't take the noise and it's a bit of a mess.
The children do not like the noise, and the room is very dirty.

feedback.es: Children, do not y very dirty dan un registro formal; kids, can't stand y a mess suenan informales.

origin.text: Informal draft: “The kids can't stand the noise, and it's a total mess.”

prompt.es: Elige la frase del borrador con el conector bien puntuado.

choices.text: The park is clean; however, it is closed on Mondays.
The park is clean, however it is closed on Mondays.
The park is clean however; it is closed on Mondays.

feedback.es: However entre dos oraciones lleva punto y coma antes y coma después; la coma sola o el punto y coma tras however son incorrectos.

prompt.es: Completa el borrador con los dos conectores que faltan.

feedback.es: Therefore introduce el resultado de que la tienda estuviera vacía y whereas contrasta dos grupos de personas.

sentences: The shop was empty; ___, the owner closed it.
Some people like cold weather, ___ others prefer heat.

prompt.es: Escucha la valoración de la profesora y elige qué opina del borrador.

choices.text: The draft is clear but too casual.
The draft has many spelling mistakes.

feedback.es: La profesora dice que el borrador es claro pero demasiado casual por el uso de jerga.

origin.audio: Your draft is clear, but the register is too casual. Replace the slang with neutral words.

prompt.es: Corrige el borrador y justifica dos cambios.

answer.text: Children do not like the new rule, although it is cheap. However, they say that it is very confusing. The teachers are going to change it; therefore, the children will be happy. I changed kids to children because the register must be formal, and I removed but because although already contrasts the ideas.
accepted: Children do not like the new rule, although it is cheap. However, they say that it is very confusing. The teachers are going to change it; therefore, the children will be happy. I changed kids to children because the register must be formal, and I removed but because although already contrasts the ideas.

The children do not like the new rule, although it is cheap. However, they say that it is very confusing. The teachers are going to change it; therefore, the children will be happy. I replaced kids with children because an essay needs a formal register, and I deleted but because although already shows contrast.

feedback.es: Un buen informe edita el registro (children, going to), corrige los conectores (although sin but; however y therefore con coma) y explica dos cambios con because.

origin.text: Borrador con seis errores: «Kids don't like the new rule, but although it is cheap. However they say it's a total mess. The teachers are gonna change it, therefore the kids is happy.» Reescríbelo en un registro formal, corrige los conectores y la concordancia y añade dos frases que justifiquen dos cambios (empieza con I changed… o I removed…).

prompt.es: Elige la frase sin error de conector.

choices.text: Whereas some students prefer notes, but others prefer recordings.
Some students prefer notes whereas, but others prefer recordings.
Whereas some students prefer notes, others prefer recordings.

feedback.es: Whereas une dos ideas contrastadas dentro de la oración; no admite but en la otra parte.

prompt.es: Completa: «El correo suena demasiado informal porque está lleno de jerga.»

feedback.es: Casual describe un registro informal; la jerga hace que un correo suene demasiado cotidiano.

origin.text: The email sounds too ___ because it is full of slang.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los resultados fueron buenos; por lo tanto, el plan continuó.»

answer.text: The results were good therefore the plan continued

feedback.es: Therefore presenta la consecuencia: el plan continuó porque los resultados fueron buenos.
